name: Shapeshifting Fiend
descr: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.

features.name: Fiendish Nature
features.text: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Impersonate
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

features.name: Turn Invisible
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make the Fiend _Hidden_ until they make an action roll or take damage.

features.name: Backhanded Guidance
features.text: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can **mark a Stress** to add **1d6** to the result of their Fear Die.

features.name: Exposed! (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.
